subject: Mutual action plan + evaluation kickoff: technical owners and timeline
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Morales <diego.morales@zenlytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan + evaluation kickoff: technical owners and timeline

Diego —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we have clear owners and a pragmatic evaluation timeline for Zenlytics' prototype with Redwood.

High-level goal: get a constrained end-to-end eval (ingest -> prompt -> inference -> metrics) running in your staging environment and produce cost/latency numbers + quality notes within two weeks.

Proposed technical owners:
- Zenlytics: Diego Morales (product lead) + Asha Rao (engineering lead) — please confirm Asha is the right eng contact.
- Redwood: Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer) — technical lead for infra, integration, and telemetry.
- Redwood: Neha Kapoor (Senior AE) — commercial owner and scheduling.

Attached: MAP_v1.xlsx (proposed milestones), evaluation-checklist.pdf (what success looks like), and env-access-template.txt (minimal access we need).

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm Asha as engineering lead and add any constraints (maintenance windows, IP blockers)?
2) Are the two-week cadence and target completion date of Oct 2 realistic from your side?
3) Please share a small sample dataset (≤50 records) and one representative prompt we can use for the first run.

If that works, Dev and I will follow up with a short technical runbook and propose three time slots for a 30-minute technical kickoff next week.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0124

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), evaluation-checklist.pdf (doc), env-access-template.txt (text)

Thanks Jasmine — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. Confirming Asha (cc'd) is the right engineering lead and will own infra provisioning on our side. Asha, we’ll need coordination on network access and a short list of required endpoints.

Quick notes from our side:
- Two-week evaluation window is tight but doable if we get access this coming Monday (Sep 21).
- We prefer using a staging VPC (no internet egress) for the first pass — we'll share firewall rules.
- Dataset: attaching a small sample (we'll send separately via secure transfer).

Asha — can you review the env-access-template and flag any corporate security steps we need to loop in? If there are legal/KR requirements, escalate and cc me.

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + evaluation kickoff: technical owners and timeline

Asha — nice to meet you (virtually). Quick technical note from my side and a proposed checklist so the eval doesn't stall: 

Minimum we need from Zenlytics to run the first integration:
- Short-lived staging credentials (API key or service account) with scoped access; see env-access-template.txt attached to Jasmine's email.
- One sample payload (you mentioned you sent it out-of-band — thanks). Please include both raw text and any metadata you want returned.
- Network: allow outbound TLS to our cluster endpoints (we can provide a CIDR). If staging is fully air-gapped we can run an on-site package, but that requires extra lead time.
- Telemetry: a small webhook endpoint or S3 bucket where we can push logs (obfuscated PII) for latency/err analysis.

Proposed technical kickoff agenda (30 min):
- Introductions (5)
- Integration + auth (8)
- Run one end-to-end sample (10)
- Next steps + owners (7)

Slots I have next week (PT): Mon 09/21 10:00–10:30, Tue 09/22 14:00–14:30, Wed 09/23 09:00–09:30. Please pick one and I'll send a calendar invite.

Also linking a short runbook we typically use: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP (contains the quick-run notebook and telemetry config).

Happy to keep this lightweight — our aim is reproducible numbers and a clear go/no-go at the end of the window.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0178

Attachment references: env-access-template.txt (see Jasmine), evaluation-checklist.pdf (for success criteria)

Diego/Asha: we will plan to start Monday 09/21 assuming you can provision the staging credentials and share the short sample. Dev will run the technical kickoff and send the calendar invite after you pick a time.

Next steps (quick):

- Zenlytics: share sample payload and staging creds (scoped) by Mon 09/21 08:00 PT.
